idealPortfolio.methodologySummary: Constructed from all holdings of the 14 funds ranked Top 10 across at least one window (TTM/3Y/2Y/18M/YTD/5Y). Each position is scored by manager multi-window percentile rank × √(portfolio weight) × multi-fund consensus multiplier × QoQ accumulation factor, then water-filled with an 8.0% single-stock cap.
